topic: Black Friday list after 40 is 3 things long (Boo-Se-Boo + Trail Bay)
text:
My Black Friday skincare list after 40 has 3 things on it:

1. Dermatology Booster EX
2. Dermatology Serum EX
3. Dermatology Cream

Booster, Serum, Booster, Cream. Let each layer dry. That's it.

Try them on your hand at Trail Bay, Sechelt: Fri Nov 27, 11 to 4, and Sun Nov 29.
picture_tip: Handwritten sticky note reading 'Black Friday list: 1. Booster 2. Serum 3. Cream' stuck beside your real Booster EX, Serum EX and Dermatology Cream on the counter, window daylight. Square or 4:5.
video_tip: 8-10s clip: pen writes the 3-item list on a sticky note, hand sets each product down as it's written, end on the Trail Bay poster. On-screen text: 'My whole Black Friday list'.

topic: Myth-bust: it's the hot water, not the cleanser
text:
Your cleanser isn't drying you out this winter. Your hot water is.

What I do instead:
1. Lukewarm water only
2. ICD Balancing Gel Cleanser
3. Pat dry with a soft cloth
4. Booster on dry skin, then wait

Save this for tonight. Where does winter hit you first?
picture_tip: Bathroom sink: Balancing Gel Cleanser beside a folded dry face cloth and Booster EX, tap in the background, soft evening light. No wet cloth on the products.
video_tip: 8-12s: hand tests the tap and turns it from hot to lukewarm (text 'Not hot'), cleanser in palm, pat dry with cloth (text 'Dry first'), spray Booster and pause (text 'Then wait').

text:
Stocking stuffers for the women over 40 on your list:

Save this for your list. 🎁
picture_tip: The four products peeking out of a red or knit stocking on a wooden table, a little fairy-light glow, logo sticker or gift tag reading Cat's Health and Beauty.
video_tip: 6-8s: hand drops each product into the stocking one by one (Balm, Lip Oil, Liner, Body Cream), final shot of the full stocking. On-screen text: 'Stocking stuffers for her, 40+'.
